content.text:
**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position met).**

No exclusivity obligation binds IBM. Key points:

- **§ 6.0 Purchase of Products (p0720)** — "IBM agrees to purchase Products" is a framework commitment tied to Purchase Orders, not a requirements or sole-source covenant; the same sentence confirms "This Agreement does not authorize MSL to produce or deliver any Product."
- **§ 6.1 (p0722)** — IBM may cancel any and all Purchase Orders at any time, which is inconsistent with exclusive dealing.
- **§ 3.0 Scope of Work (p0102)** — covers only "selected" manufacturing, Integration and Services.
- **§ 9.0(e) (p0186)** — expressly contemplates "reductions of Products requirements due to migration to a competitive supplier," affirming our freedom to source elsewhere; it only allocates severance cost for Transferred Employees.
- The only "exclusive" hits are unrelated: entire-agreement language (p1500), MSL's exclusive remedy (p1574), and secure media storage (p1341).

No redline proposed; nothing to narrow, and no Customer-favourable exclusivity to preserve.
